lines: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord, is this one duty and nothing beyond: my pride, offered at Your lotus feet in devotion.
This is my all; nothing else do I know. Having cast all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, ocean of compassion — be pleased.
sanskrit_cite: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava
notes: prasāda as ‘pleased’ (pleasure reading); grace reading open — see argmap
